facts.business: Vedavaag Systems Limited is an Indian listed company with subsidiaries, preparing consolidated financial statements under Ind AS, and has investments in power plants and subsidiaries.
key_risks: Impairment of power plants due to changes in assumptions on tariff rates, plant load factors, fuel costs, and future cash flows
Post-employment benefit plan obligations sensitive to actuarial assumptions
Assets held for sale classification requires significant judgment
Financial instruments fair value measurement approximations
